recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17699 unless the work group reopens the broader modifier-extension handling policy.
issue_request: FHIR-17699 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core clarification for the extensibility page. It asked to add a note that Exchanging Extensions describes non-modifier extensions except where modifier extensions are explicitly mentioned, and to qualify the Summary: Handling extensions guidance so unknown modifier extensions are not handled like ordinary ignored extensions.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#f536a40888, and commit f536a40888561aa716bad59f9e1a1686d6aa3c16 applied both requested changes to source/extensibility.html by inserting the non-modifier note and appending the modifier-extension exception to the handling summary bullet.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps extension=extensibility, so source/extensibility.html is in current build scope. Later FHIR-18362 refined the same summary bullet to say unrecognized non-modifier extensions should be preserved when possible and ignored only when preservation is impossible, while retaining that unrecognized modifier extensions require special handling as described above. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-17699-specific community record contradicting this interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has the requested non-modifier note and an updated summary sentence that preserves FHIR-17699's modifier-extension distinction without retaining the obsolete literal wording.

related_jiras.note: Later published same-page clarification replaced the old 'ignore other extensions except for modifier extensions' summary text while preserving FHIR-17699's modifier-extension special-handling rule.
